_description: Selects the strongest photos from what was submitted, identifies specific visual gaps, and generates a targeted shot list aligned to the dog's story.

visual_impact.gap: Single shot, fluorescent lighting, no eye contact.

photo_gaps: No eye contact — dog is looking away from camera
Fluorescent shelter lighting — removes warmth and personality
Single angle — no full body, no action, no human connection

shot_list.description: Eye-level, natural light. Get on the floor. Moose looks at the camera, not past it.
shot_list.why: Eye contact in natural light is the single strongest predictor of faster adoption.

shot_list.description: Mid-fetch action shot. Ball in the air, Moose in motion.
shot_list.why: Fetch is his personality hook — show it, don't say it.

shot_list.description: Calm moment on the couch or floor with foster.
shot_list.why: This is the dog people actually bring home. The one who fits into a life.

response.coaching_note: Three photos. 20 minutes. Completely changes this listing.
